description: This module only supports oVirt/RHEV version 3.

parameters.name: boot_order
parameters.description: This option uses complex arguments and is a list of items that specify the bootorder. Default: ["hd", "network"]

parameters.name: cd_drive
parameters.description: The CD you wish to have mounted on the VM when state=cd.

parameters.name: cluster
parameters.description: The RHEV/oVirt cluster in which you want you VM to start. Default: ""

parameters.name: cpu_share
parameters.description: This parameter is used to configure the CPU share. Default: 0

parameters.name: datacenter
parameters.description: The RHEV/oVirt datacenter in which you want you VM to start. Default: "Default"

parameters.name: del_prot
parameters.description: This option sets the delete protection checkbox. Choices: false true ← (default)

parameters.name: disks
parameters.description: This option uses complex arguments and is a list of disks with the options name, size, and domain.

parameters.name: ifaces
parameters.description: This option uses complex arguments and is a list of interfaces with the options name and vlan.

parameters.name: image
parameters.description: The template to use for the VM.

parameters.name: insecure_api
parameters.description: A boolean switch to make a secure or insecure connection to the server. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: mempol
parameters.description: The minimum amount of memory you wish to reserve for this system. Default: 1

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The name of the VM.

parameters.name: osver
parameters.description: The operating system option in RHEV/oVirt. Default: "rhel_6x64"

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: The password for user authentication.

parameters.name: port
parameters.description: The port on which the API is reachable. Default: 443

parameters.name: server
parameters.description: The name/IP of your RHEV-m/oVirt instance. Default: "127.0.0.1"

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: This serves to create/remove/update or powermanage your VM. Choices: "absent" "cd" "down" "info" "ping" "present" ← (default) "restarted" "up"

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.description: The timeout you wish to define for power actions. When state=up. When state=down. When state=restarted.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: To define if the VM is a server or desktop. Choices: "desktop" "host" "server" ← (default)

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: The user to authenticate with. Default: "admin@internal"

parameters.name: vm_ha
parameters.description: To make your VM High Available. Choices: false true ← (default)

parameters.name: vmcpu
parameters.description: The number of CPUs you want in your VM. Default: 2

parameters.name: vmhost
parameters.description: The host you wish your VM to run on.

parameters.name: vmmem
parameters.description: The amount of memory you want your VM to use (in GB). Default: 1

examples:
- name: Basic get info from VM
  community.general.rhevm:
    server: rhevm01
    user: '{{ rhev.admin.name }}'
    password: '{{ rhev.admin.pass }}'
    name: demo
    state: info

- name: Basic create example from image
  community.general.rhevm:
    server: rhevm01
    user: '{{ rhev.admin.name }}'
    password: '{{ rhev.admin.pass }}'
    name: demo
    cluster: centos
    image: centos7_x64
    state: present

- name: Power management
  community.general.rhevm:
    server: rhevm01
    user: '{{ rhev.admin.name }}'
    password: '{{ rhev.admin.pass }}'
    cluster: RH
    name: uptime_server
    image: centos7_x64
    state: down

- name: Multi disk, multi nic create example
  community.general.rhevm:
    server: rhevm01
    user: '{{ rhev.admin.name }}'
    password: '{{ rhev.admin.pass }}'
    cluster: RH
    name: server007
    type: server
    vmcpu: 4
    vmmem: 2
    ifaces:
      - name: eth0
        vlan: vlan2202
      - name: eth1
        vlan: vlan36
      - name: eth2
        vlan: vlan38
      - name: eth3
        vlan: vlan2202
    disks:
      - name: root
        size: 10
        domain: ssd-san
      - name: swap
        size: 10
        domain: 15kiscsi-san
      - name: opt
        size: 10
        domain: 15kiscsi-san
      - name: var
        size: 10
        domain: 10kiscsi-san
      - name: home
        size: 10
        domain: sata-san
    boot_order:
      - network
      - hd
    state: present

- name: Add a CD to the disk cd_drive
  community.general.rhevm:
    user: '{{ rhev.admin.name }}'
    password: '{{ rhev.admin.pass }}'
    name: server007
    cd_drive: rhev-tools-setup.iso
    state: cd

- name: New host deployment + host network configuration
  community.general.rhevm:
    password: '{{ rhevm.admin.pass }}'
    name: ovirt_node007
    type: host
    cluster: rhevm01
    ifaces:
      - name: em1
      - name: em2
      - name: p3p1
        ip: 172.31.224.200
        netmask: 255.255.254.0
      - name: p3p2
        ip: 172.31.225.200
        netmask: 255.255.254.0
      - name: bond0
        bond:
          - em1
          - em2
        network: rhevm
        ip: 172.31.222.200
        netmask: 255.255.255.0
        management: true
      - name: bond0.36
        network: vlan36
        ip: 10.2.36.200
        netmask: 255.255.254.0
        gateway: 10.2.36.254
      - name: bond0.2202
        network: vlan2202
      - name: bond0.38
        network: vlan38
    state: present

return_values.name: vm
